dedupe_keys.name: wind turbine blade fault vibration under varied wind speeds

description: This deposit provides vibration measurements for laboratory wind-turbine blade fault diagnosis at Mustansiriyah University in Baghdad. The producer records healthy operation and induced blade defects under different wind speeds. Repository metadata specify one-kilohertz acquisition, five hundred samples per channel and thirty-five condition files. The current version 4 inventory contains CSV measurements and is free under CC BY 4.0. The article cites an earlier release and includes a twisted-blade condition alongside cracking, erosion and imbalance; the brief repository description lists fewer fault categories. Coverage is a laboratory apparatus, with no common calendar span established, and short induced-fault traces are not operational failure rates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing vibration signatures or condition-monitoring components in wind-turbine simulations. model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin is a related modelling resource, although sensor definitions and model states were not mapped. No classification experiment or signal processing was run.
name: Wind-turbine blade fault vibration under varied wind speeds
